name: @pipeworx/mcp-wikiviews

tools.name: get_article_views
tools.description: Get daily pageview counts for a specific Wikipedia article over a date range. Dates must be in YYYYMMDD format.

title.description: Wikipedia article title, URL-encoded if needed (e.g. "Albert_Einstein")

tools.name: get_top_articles
tools.description: Get the most viewed Wikipedia articles for a specific day. Returns up to 1000 articles ranked by view count.

tools.name: get_project_views
tools.description: Get aggregate daily pageview totals for all of English Wikipedia over a date range. Dates must be in YYYYMMDD format.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-wikiviews forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the wikiviews pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
